description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled “N” and “AUC (%)” for multiple lines. The x-axis is labeled “N” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The plot contains five lines. The first line is colored blue, uses circle markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (0, 92) and ends at approximately (20, 94). The second line is colored orange, uses square markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (0, 82) and ends at approximately (20, 91). The third line is colored green, uses star markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (0, 88) and ends at approximately (20, 92). The fourth line is colored purple, uses triangle markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (0, 78) and ends at approximately (20, 85). The fifth line is colored teal, uses diamond markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately (0, 91) and ends at approximately (20, 93).
